provenance.brief: Name a Telugu film scored by S. Thaman.

quotes.Kick: His debut releases as a music director were Kick in Telugu and Sindhanai Sei in Tamil, both of which released in 2009.
quotes.Dookudu: 2012: Best Music Director – Telugu for Dookudu
quotes.Baadshah: Naayak (2013), Baadshah (2013), Greeku Veerudu (2013), Ramayya Vasthavayya (2013)
quotes.Ramayya Vasthavayya: Greeku Veerudu (2013), Ramayya Vasthavayya (2013), Race Gurram (2014)
quotes.Aagadu: Race Gurram (2014), Aagadu (2014), Bruce Lee: The Fighter (2015)
quotes.Bruce Lee: The Fighter: Aagadu (2014), Bruce Lee: The Fighter (2015), Sarrainodu (2016)
quotes.Sarrainodu: TSR TV9 Awards 2016 – Best Music Director for Sarrainodu, Srirastu Subhamastu.
quotes.Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo: 2022: 68th National Film Awards – Best Music Direction for Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
quotes.Akhanda: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo (2020), Akhanda (2021), Sarkaru Vaari Paata (2022)
quotes.Sarkaru Vaari Paata: Akhanda (2021), Sarkaru Vaari Paata (2022), Varisu (2023), and Daaku Maharaaj (2025).
quotes.Daaku Maharaaj: Sarkaru Vaari Paata (2022), Varisu (2023), and Daaku Maharaaj (2025).
quotes.Malli Malli: Thaman made his debut as a composer in through the Telugu feature film Malli Malli (2009), although the soundtrack album was released in 2008.
quotes.Guntur Kaaram: Kurchi Madathapetti from Guntur Kaaram (2024), with around 839 million views
quotes.DJ Tillu: Other widely viewed songs include “Tillu Anna DJ Pedithe” from DJ Tillu (2022), with around 400 million views
quotes.Fidaa: and Vachinde from Fidaa (2017), with approximately 385 million views.
quotes.Bheemla Nayak: 2023: Nominated – Best Music Director – Telugu for Bheemla Nayak
quotes.Srirastu Subhamastu: TSR TV9 Awards 2016 – Best Music Director for Sarrainodu, Srirastu Subhamastu.
quotes.Kick 2: GAMA Awards 2016 – Best Love song "Nuvve Nuvve" in Kick 2.
quotes.Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava: 17th Santosham Film Awards 2019 – Best Music Director Award for Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava (2018).
